balls.text: makes a lot of room and swings and the ball takes the inside edge and spins away behind the stumps
full and swinging in and he punches it hard down to long-off
he swings wildly at a slower ball and the ball clips the inside edge and beats the keeper, lucky boundary
Kumble punches a full delivery hard down the pitch and Irfan fields it
the legstump goes for an evening walk! He delivers a slanting yorker from over the wicket and Pankaj swings and misses and his leg stump takes a tumble

Praveen takes the risk of blocking all three stumps and that made him a candidate for an lbw, Pathan bowls from over the wicket and slants it towards the leg stump, Praveen moves to the off stump and exposes the leg stump
full outside off and punched hard down to long-off
yorker outside off and squirted to third man, they push hard for the second and make it
gets across his stumps to a pitched up delivery and flicks it, he gets a lot of elevation and Jayawardene takes it easily at deep square leg
That's a Taylor special! He fetches that from the offstump and hoicks him across the line and smacks the ball over the second tier at deep midwicket
swings at a wide delivery outside off and they steal a bye
flicks him to midwicket and scampers to the other end
take that! It's a slower ball and Praveen picks it early and clubs it over deep midwicket, that was all power
makes room and VRV fires a yorker on the stumps and he manages to dig it out
he makes room and flays at that and the ball sails over the slips, unorthodox but that defines Praveen Kumar
hits the deck hard on a good length and Kohli tries to smack him over the on side but mistimes the shot and Bopara takes a sitter at short midwicket
chips down the track and he fires a full toss, he somehow nudges it to the on side
he moves across his stumps very early and VRV errs by pitching it up, he smacks that high over extra cover
digs it in short and he hops and fends it to the off side
tempts him with width and he swishes hard outside off and fails to make contact
digs it in short and he gets his elbows high and punches it hard down to deep cover
hoicks him across the line and Pathan mops up at long-leg
bowls the short ball and takes a lot of pace off it, that traps Kallis who goes for the pull but doesn't get the timing or the distance to clear the rope, Jayawardene takes it at deep square-leg
fullish outside off and he frees his arms and the ball flies off the top edge and lands well short of third man
he tries to smack that out of the stadium with one hand, didn't make for a very pleasant sight
starts off with a loosener really wide of the offstump
full marks for placement! He stands outside leg to give himself room and he slices it past the gap between short third man and point, that scorched to the boundary
slower ball and he pushes it down the ground to long-off
driven to long-off
of cutter and he plays it to point for a sharp single
cracks this high over wide mid-off and Mahela does well to slide and cut it off at the boundary
Kallis means business tonight! He stands outside leg and slams a pitched up delivery straight over the bowler and it lands just short of the rope at wide long-off
taps it to short third man and searches for the single
pushed down the track
tries to slog sweep that from way outside off and he misses it completely, short third man dives in vain to pull it back
Taylor gives it his all and deposits that a few rows over deep square leg, he gets on his knee and slogs him with brute force
gifts him width and he reaches out and flays it to deep point, he's looked solid today
he chips it across the line to long-on and pushes the second, that's a fifty for Kallis
lands on middle and leg and he works it to the on side for a single
walks down the track to unsettle the bowler and he digs it short, Kallis clubs it with intent and the fielder runs across from deep square leg and dives in vain
driven off the front foo to long-off for a single
a genuine cricket shot and the crowd applaud that, gets width outside off and he thumps it on the up wide of extra cover, that was four the moment it left the bat
no slip and Taylor exploits the gap, chases a wide delivery and gets a thick outside edge
closes the face of the bat and punches it hard down to short cover
there was width to flay his arms and Kallis did exactly that, unfortunately he failed to make contact
full again and pushed through the line to long-off
full on the offstump and he punches it to long-off
stays back and punches it down to mid-off
gets beside the line and taps it to the covers
starts off with a full delivery on the pads and Kallis pushes it through the line to long-on
transfers his weight on the backfoot and punches it straight to midwicket
gets across the stumps and works it past the vacant midwicket region and Yuvraj sprints across and does the chasing
shuffles and nudges it wide of midwicket again
the arm ball and he chips it down to midwicket
full outside off and he places it wide of cover
flighted outside off Kallis gets on his knee, gets underneath the ball and carves it elegantly over deep extra cover
the straighter one and he punches it hard back to the bowler
the googly this time and he gets nicely behind the line and defends
full outside off and driven to long-off

trouble for Bangalore as Dravid departs! He chips down the track to go downtown but fails to get to the pitch of the ball, the ball swirls in the air for a while and VRV Singh sprints from long-on to his left and takes it comfortably, Chawla deserves credit for cutting back on the pace and giving it more flight
full outside off and driven wide of deep point
makes a bit of room but Chawla fires it on a  yorker length, well bowled
driven to deep cover for a single
takes a quick singe to the covers and Dravid has to rush to his crease, sharper fielding would have had in in trouble
defended to cover point
he crashes a full delivery through the off side and Mahela makes a hash of it at short cover, that should have been stopped
floated on the pads and he misses it again
shapes to cut but misses, well that was close to the edge
goes for the cover drive and gets a thick inside edge to the on side
chipped in the air but safe, the ball is placed towards mid-on
drien to long-off for a single
extra flight and he carves it high over cover, there's protection in the deep
another straight ball and he places it square on the off side
mistimes the drive and Chawla fields off his own bowling
too early on the sweep and the ball rolls to the on side
gets on his knee for a pre-meditated sweep and he gets a top edge down to square leg
tries to drive straight but gets an inside edge to the on side
worked against the turn to the on side
pushed against the turn to mid-on
he powers a full delivery outside off with a square drive and Pathan at the boundary dives in vain
full outside off and driven to long-off
gets down early for the sweep and connects well, deep square leg does the fielding
attempts a firm cut but the ball keeps low and creeps underneath the bat
full on the pads and worked past midwicket
Yuvraj fields like a tiger at short cover, that was slammed hard by Kallis
rocks back, gives width and chops it to the covers
just opens the face of the bat and slices it softly to the off side, that ends a very productive over
hops at the crease and tucks it softly towards short square leg and sets off

that's a very tame dismissal and Abdulla is the toast of Kingsmead! Pietersen hangs his bat out at a delivery moving away from him and decides to check his shot, Goel takes an easy catch at short cover Pietersen could have left that ball instead of reaching out to that slower ball
that's a huge sigh of relief for Punjab! Ryder fails to pick the slower offcutter and swings across the line and misses it completely, the stumps are erect but the bails fly in different directions
he drives to deep exra cover and Chawla saves a boundary with a terrific sliding stop, that's commitment for you
the ball stops on Kallis but he checks his shot and fends it wide of point
an attempted yorker turns into a friendly full toss and Ryder accepts the gift and pummels it over midwicket
lands it on a full length outside off and he pushes it to cover point
Ryder chips one dangerously and the ball falls short of mid-off, he just checked his shot
you bowl it there and I'll whack it there! Short and wide outside off and he frees his arms and carves it over backward point, Punjab aren't bowling the right lengths to Ryder
keeps a check on Ryder by firing in a yorker and he does well to dig it out
the slower ball and he gets beside the line and steers it to cover point
flashes at a wide delivery outside off and Abdulla is penalised
pushes it firmly down the track to mid-on and he pushes the single immediately
in the length to play that powerful cover drive but he finds extra cover
it's a low full toss and he pushes it hard down to extra cover
full outside off and he punches it hard square of the wicket on the off side
pitched up wide outside off and Kallis gets forward, reaches out a bit and carves it over backward point
Ryder to the storm! Bose's nightmare continues as yet another full delivery is dismissed, this time the drive is squarer and he cracks it past extra cover
he crashes a half volley past the covers with brute force and had mid-off been there even he couldn't have stopped it
he errs by overpitching outside off and he swings across the line and skies the ball towards wide long-on, a couple of bounces and four
tries to squirt it through the off side with soft hands
connects well with a flashy square drive but the fielder at cover does well to slide and get a hand to it
a shot of intent, he fetches that from outside off, gets a touch forward and whacks it past the gap between extra cover and mid-off
bowls it really wide outside of and he chases it and hits it pretty hard, keeps cover busy
shuffles and works it past square leg
that was class! Patha pitches it short down the leg side and Kallis pivots at the crease and pulls so effortlessly over long leg, the timing was the key and man that was a pleasant shot
gets forward and drives softly to the covers
that appeared to clip his pad very close to the line of the stumps before reaching the keeper, the ball kept a bit low

he chases a really wide delivery and Pathan gets away with a loosener, so full and wide outside off and Uthappa succumbs to temptation, the ball catches the top edge of the bat and heads to Yuvraj who cups it at first slip
strays on the pads and he works it to deep midwicket with a flick of the wrists, there's protection in the deep
cramps him for room bur he gets beside the line and slices it down to point
full and driven straight down the practice pitch and mid-off runs across and cuts it off
and finally Ryder is among the runs! A little short and wide and he rocks on the backfoot and thumps it past extra cover
lands on a good length and he gets forward and defends
and Jesse Ryder gets bat on ball but not off the mark, it's a leading edge to the off side
and he finishes it off with a stylish six down long-off! He gets forward and scoops it effortlessly over long-off, that's the 100th six of the tournament
down the leg side and wide
all timing! And power too, it's a full delivery on the pads and Yuvraj chips it really hard past the bowler and long-on fails to get t it
tucks him for room and Jayawardene adjusts well by tapping it softly in front of cover and setting off quickly
fullish on the pads and he clips it down to midwicket
full on the pads and he works it hard down to wide long-on

Kallis bowls the slower one and it's a rare blip in concentration from Bopara who fails to read it early and gets a top edge as he tries to slog, Ryder runs forward and takes it at midwicket sliding forward
fullish outside off and he scoops it down to third man
That's out of Kingsmead! Can we have the ball back please? He stays at the crease and with little effort tonks it over wide long-on, the crowd had to crank their necks to see where it had gone
fires the yorker outside off and the ball just clips the pads and rolls to the keeper, Uthappa ges distracted by the appeal and tamely under arms the ball to the stumps
squirts it in the gap between square leg and midwicket for a single
the full toss is a suicidal delivery at this stage and Ryder pays for it as Bopara wallops it over wide long-on
full in length outside off and he squeezes it down to deep point
a costly error by Kallis as he slips this one down the legside and Yuvraj gets a faint trickle past the keeper, 13 off this over
fullish outside off and he smashes it hard down to long-off
the ball stops on him a bit and he checks his shot and drives to long-off
drops it fuller and angles it across the left hander, KP mops up at deep midwicket
typical Yuvraj, he waits at the crease and seizes on the short delivery from round the wicket, he clubs it over deep midwicket
slides it full and on the pads and he clips it down to deep midwicket
that's a low full toss from round the wicket and he chips it down to long-on
offcutter and he cuts it backward of point and Ryder slides and cuts it off
that's a low full toss and Bopara's enjoying this over, he swings across the line and sends the ball at least 7 rows back over deep square-leg
slides down the legside and well the ball just clips his bat and runs past the keeper for four
overpitched on middle and leg and he enjoys a free swing of the arms and takes him downtown over long-on, super shot
wide down the leg side and the ball clips Yuvraj's boot, that would have been a wide
rocks back and pulls hard to deep square leg, there are  2 fielders patroling that area
rocks back and places it well wide of deep point and Kohli mops up
the quicker one, Yuvraj gets forward and steers it down towards point and calls for a sharp single
he rocks back, waits for the turn and slaps it towards point
spins towards leg and he moves across and clips it to the on side
shuffles and clips it to the on side for a single
tries to squirt it past point and Ryder does brilliantly to cut it off
that breaks the shackles! Drops it short of a length and he gets tremendous bat speed on that one as he clubs it just in front of the deep midwicket rope
fullish outside off and he swings across the line and he gets a thick inside edge to the on side
squares him up in front of the middle stumps and he gets a leading edge down to deep point
full outside off and driven down the ground to long-off
shuffles and works it with the turn to square leg
makes room and slaps him hard but can't beat Ryder at short cover
shuffles and clips it to short fine leg
Sangakkara tries to loft him  downtown but fails to get the desired elevation, he gets on his knee  and tries to scoop it over long-off but Pankaj takes it
the flipper beats him completely, well bowled
innovative shot! He moves really far across his stumps and just manages to paddle scoop it away past the keepr, Kumble dives but fails to cut it off
gets forward and pushes it hard down to long-off for a single
well bowled again, Bopara thuds it hard down the pitch and can't beat Ryder
slower delivery and he opens the face of the bat and slices it to point
makes room to a full delivery and clubs it along he turf to long-on
full on middle and off and he pushes this down the ground to long-on
nudged to the on side for a single
defended back to the bowler
rocks back and slams it down to deep cover
rocks back and cuts to deep point and Kallis fires the throw a bit wide of the stumps and Sangakara makes his ground
the straighter one and Kohli fumbles at point, Bopara decides not to go for the single
slower off the air and he shuffles and clips it to the on side
drops it to short cover and takes a single
beats the batsman and deflects off the keeper, sorry it was given as a bye
chips down the track on seeing the flight and he scoops it dead straight over the bowler's head, clean strike
gets on his knee and slogs him with power and bisects the gap perfectly in the region of deep square leg, awesome placement
gets down the track nd nearly chips it on the full back to the bowler
makes room and cuts to he off side
stays back and punches with the turn to long-on
plays a reverse paddle and Praveen does really well at short third man to slide and cut it off, he injured his ankle some time back
full on the pads and he clips it behind square on the on side and he puts pressure on Kohli
floated on the pads and he works it to the on side
he tries to cut but the ball really skids off the pitch and beats him
gets behind the line and defends own the track
rocks back, waits for the turn and cuts to the off side
Dravid Drops a simple one! Sanga chips down and gets a thick top edge to midwicket, Dravid pedals back and fluffs it
taps it to short cover, tells his partner to wait and stays back
short outside off, no turn, he rocks back and slaps it down to deep point
full outside off and he pushes it to long-off
edged and down to third man! Tough one for Uthappa as there was no slip, he delivers from round the wicket and Bopara drives and gets a thick outside edge
gets a bit of extra bounce and he hops and takes a quick single to short cover

excellent pick up and throw by Vinay Kumar! Goel opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man, Vinay slides to his right and releases the ball quickly, he fires it flat to Uthappa who whips of the stump, the third umpire takes a look, he was just short of his ground
slants it across the right-hander and he opens the face of the bat and steers it to third man
comes round the wicket and he defends
shot! Short delivery which sits up nicely and Bopara gets on top of the bounce and clubs him over deep midwicket, nice timing
cuts to Kohli at point and he fires the throw to the bowler's end, the ball deflects off Bopara and runs away, they dont take any runs
moves across the stumps and he clips it to the on side
crashes a full delivery outside off and deep extra cover cuts it off
pulls him to square leg
Dropped Goel slashes hard outside off and Kohli at point tries to catch it one handed, he had little time to react
leading edge and Vinay Kumar makes a desperate attempt to pull off a stunner off his own bowling, the ball rolls to mid-off
gets beside the line and squirts it to the off side for a single
plays too early and chops it to the off side and they take another sharp single
catches him off guard with a bouncer and Goel goes for the hook and just manages to evade it
gets a thick inside and the ball dribbles in front of the stumps and he sets off
slower ball and short and he taps it with soft hands and sets off
Bopara fails to control the pull but luckily the mis-hit falls short of the fielder
sloppy from Uthappa, Kallis drifts the slower ball down the leg side and Uthappa lets it slip between his legs
shuffles and clips him to the on side
lovely shot, the ball is fractionally short and he pulls from the off stump and places it behind square on the on side, he picked his spot perfectly and the fielder at deep square had no chance
taps it wide of cover point and sets off, Kohli does the fielding
moves across his stumps and clips it across the line to deep square leg
waits for the ball to come onto him and taps it wide of point for a single
he reaches out to a full delivery and slices it over the slips and wide of Kallis at third man
shuffles and clips this one to the on side of his legs
Appeal! Goel gives the charge and swings, there's a sound and Uthappa and Praveen appeal for a catch, the umpire shakes his head, I need to see another replay of that
Praveen sprints across the pitch to field off his own bowling and on one motion slides and takes aim at the stumps, he misses and what's worse - Praveen has injured his ankle
steps back and pulls to deep square leg
shuffles across his stumps and clips him wide of midwicket
taps it with soft hands in front of short cover and Kohli misfields, slips and thuds to the ground
drops it close  to the stumps and sets off, Bopara was too quick for the keeper Uthappa who underarms the ball on to the stumps
comes round the wicket and sprays it wide outside off, he flashes hard and misses it completely
he pivots at the crease and pulls a short delivery over midwicket, he didn't get too much distance on that and KP does really well to chase and pull it back
he bowls it too full and wide outside off and that gives Goel the chance to free his arms and carve it over backward point
much closer to the offstump and Goel dangerously fishes at it, he gets good bounce and carry
Goel half heartedly slashes outside the off stump and Pankaj gets a lot of away movement
rises up on the body and he shuffles and clips it to the on side
gets a bit of bite from the surface and gets it to cut away from the right hander
drops it slightly short and he taps it with soft hands wide of Kohli at point and sets of quickly
keeps it on a good length and straight, he softly taps it back to the bowler
kicks up off a good length and catches him high on the waist, the ball rolls to the off side
angles it on the body and he shuffles and clips it away to square leg
this one keeps a bit low and Bopara taps it softly down to mid-off
Bopara shoulders arms again and gauges the swing
maybe a bit harsh, lands outside off and Bopara shoulders arms
